title: Sikakɔkɔɔ a Ɔbɔ Asereserew wɔ Sare so
intro: Fa w’adwene bu sare so nsraban kɛse bi wɔ bere tiaa bi a woretwɛn na wuntumi nsi pi mu. Ɔkannifo kɛse bi akɔ ne Ɔsoro no akɔyɛ nhyiam, na wagyaw mpɔtam bi a wɔn ho pere wɔn sɛ wobenya biribi a wotumi hu a wɔbɛkura mu. Wɔ saa home a ɛnyɛ ahomegye no mu no, onipa bi a ɔtwetwe adwene tu anammɔn kɔ n’anim de bɔhyɛ ahorow a ɛhyerɛn ne abɔde a ɔyɛ anifere a ɛte sɛ nea ɛte ase.
clues: Na meka wɔn a wɔne Musa fii Misraim no ho, na mihui sɛ ɛpo no mu paapaee maa yɛn guankɔbea.
Mehwɛɛ berɛ a yɛn kannifoɔ kɔɔ bepɔ no so anadwo aduanan sɛ ɔrekɔgye akwankyerɛ.
Meboaboaa ahosiesie ano fii nkurɔfo no hɔ na mede m’ankasa me nsa hyehyɛe.
Meyɛɛ nantwi ba bi a ɛma nnyigyei a ɛyɛ hu, na mefrɛɛ nkurɔfo no baa hɔ.
Mefaa mfutuma nsa biako fii ɔbɔfo no kwan so na metow guu nea meyɛe no mu.
Musa hyiaa me na wɔbuu me fɔ sɛ menka sɛ ‘nka me ho’ na mentena baabiara, a wɔhyɛɛ me bɔ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhyiamu ama atemmuo.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
